about: Herb and ore nodes per zone map and kind: every spawn of the Forever TrinityCore world database as "x,y,u" (map percent, Era frame unless f is "l"; u = the chance the spawn pools keep it up) and the kind's respawn in seconds (spawns that return only after a day or more are left out); yields: items one node gives, and skins: items one skinning gives per beast level, from players' gathers in Polestar_Recorder sessions. Written by `node tools/polestar.js profession gathering nodes` (tools/lib/professions/gathering/nodes.js); read by the gathering guides' farming loops.
